description_en: Describes the basic information about an AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL database
description_zh: 描述一个adbpg数据库的基本信息
kebab_example: aliyun gpdb describe-database --db-instance-id gp-xxxxxxxxx --database-name test01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDatabase

parameters.help_en:
The cluster ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html operation to query the information about all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances within a region, including instance IDs
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html接口查看目标地域下所有的AnalyticDB PostgreSQL版实例的详情，包括实例ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the database that you want to query
parameters.name: database_name

CharacterSetName.description_en:
The character set.

For more information about the value range, see Document https://www.postgresql.org/docs/current/multibyte.html
CharacterSetName.description_zh:
字符集。

取值范围可以参考文档 https://www.postgresql.org/docs/current/multibyte.html

Collate.description_en:
Database locale parameter that specifies string comparison and sorting rules.



The locale must be compatible with the character set specified by the CharacterSetName parameter.

Collate: You can query available collations using the command SELECT DISTINCT collname FROM pg_collation;. If not specified, the default value is en_US.utf8
Collate.description_zh:
数据库区域设置参数，指定字符串比较/排序规则。

语言环境必须与 CharacterSetName 参数设置的字符集兼容。
Collate 取值：可通过SELECT DISTINCT collname FROM pg_collation; 命令查询获取，不配置时默认为 en_US.utf8

ConnLimit.description_en: Limits the number of concurrent connections. -1 indicates unlimited
ConnLimit.description_zh: 限制并发量，-1 代表未限制

Ctype.description_en:
Database locale parameter that specifies character classification and case conversion rules.



The locale must be compatible with the character set specified by the CharacterSetName parameter.

You can execute the SELECT DISTINCT collctype FROM pg_collation; statement to obtain the field value. The default value is en_US.utf8
Ctype.description_zh:
数据库区域设置参数，指定字符分类/大小写转换规则。

语言环境必须与 CharacterSetName 参数设置的字符集兼容。
可通过SELECT DISTINCT collctype FROM pg_collation; 命令查询获取，不配置时默认为 en_US.utf8

DatabaseName.description_en:
The database name.

Only contain letters, digits, and underscores (_).
Must start with a letter.
Up to 63 characters in length
DatabaseName.description_zh:
数据库名称。

只能包含字母，数字和下划线。

必须以字母开头。

长度不能超过63 个字符

Description.example: A user management database storing customer profiles.

Owner.description_en:
The owner of the table.

Contain lowercase letters, digits, and underscores (_).
Must start with a lowercase letter and end with a lowercase letter or a digit.
Cannot start with gp.
Must be 2 to 16 characters in length
Owner.description_zh:
表的拥有者。

由小写字母，数字，下划线组成。

以小写字母开头，小写字母或数字结尾。

不能以gp 开头。

长度为2~16 个字符

RequestId.description_en: The unique ID of the request
